- `ew boot`：保持 CO5300 常亮（LVGL `/dev/lcd0`），并做 PA28 蜂鸣自检。  
- `ew buzz`：无源蜂鸣器（VCC=40P.2，GND=40P.14，IO=PA28/40P.23，2~5 kHz）。  
- `ew alert`：串口 + 四级屏色 + PA28 蜂鸣。  
- `ew wifi ping` / `ew at`：ESP AT（PA24/PA25 → `/dev/ttyS2` @115200）。SSID 不进仓，空 SSID 只测 AT / SmartConfig。

## 接入编译

function Pulse-Dtr {
  try {
    $sp = New-Object System.IO.Ports.SerialPort COM7, 115200, 'None', 8, 'One'
    $sp.DtrEnable = $true
    $sp.RtsEnable = $false
    $sp.Open()
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 80
    $sp.DtrEnable = $false
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 80
    $sp.DtrEnable = $true
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 80
    $sp.DtrEnable = $false
    $sp.Close()
    Write-Host "DTR pulse done"
  } catch { Write-Host "DTR pulse fail: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
}

Pulse-Dtr
Write-Host "==== try 115200 compat no_reset ===="
& $sf -c SF32LB52 -p COM7 -b 115200 --compat true --before no_reset --connect-attempts 8 write_flash --verify "${bin}@0x12010000"
Write-Host "exit $LASTEXITCODE"
if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { exit 0 }

Pulse-Dtr
Write-Host "==== try 115200 compat default_reset ===="
& $sf -c SF32LB52 -p COM7 -b 115200 --compat true --before default_reset --connect-attempts 8 write_flash --verify "${bin}@0x12010000"
Write-Host "exit $LASTEXITCODE"
exit $LASTEXITCODE
